text:
```yaml
name: Compile Time Tracker

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  track-compile-times:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'
        cache: 'pip'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install -e .
    
    - name: Build project
      run: |
        mkdir -p build
        cd build
        cmake ..
        make -j$(nproc)
    
    - name: Run compile time tracking
      run: |
        python scripts/track_compile_times.py
        
    - name: Upload compile time data
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: compile-times
        path: compile_times.json
```
